tldr: Lilith in the 4th house: the wound and the wild in home and family
body: Lilith in the 4th house: the wound and the wild in home and family. Where you reclaim a self the family tried to suppress. Watch: repeating or weaponizing old family pain. The ungovernable self lives at home and in family; you refuse the roles you were assigned there. A deep wound around home and family: a restlessness that never quite feels at home and an urge to cut roots, paired with sharp perception of other people's hidden motives. It can also mark a significant early event or focus involving a parent or the family home, carried forward as a heavy, formative weight.
business: Reclaims power over your own roots and private life.
shadow: Family rupture, or a home life ruled by old repression.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
